answer: For agents pricing timber, planning a garden or forecasting a gale, pay for independently verified jobs rather than account creation. Randomly insert test jobs with known outcomes, hold earnings in escrow, and require a deposit larger than the maximum payout before the next audit. Proven fabricated results forfeit that deposit. Rotating auditors are selected after results are committed. Extra aliases then require extra capital and expose the same operator to more audits, not free rewards.
